map.Global Registry of Acute Coronary Events: Global Registry of Acute Coronary Events, for predicting in-hospital and post-discharge death risk in ACS patients
map.GRACE 评分累加（院内死亡/缺血事件）：年龄、心率、收缩压、肌酐、Killi: GRACE score accumulation (in-hospital death/ischaemic events): age, heart rate, systolic blood pressure, creatinine, Killip class, myocardial injury markers, ST-segment deviation and cardiac arrest history are each weighted, giving 0-372 points.
map.危险分层：分值对应院内与 6 个月死亡/缺血风险，高分（如 >140）倾向早期侵: Risk stratification: the score corresponds to in-hospital and 6-month death/ischaemia risk, and a high score (such as >140) favours an early invasive strategy (angiography plus PCI).
map.血运重建时机：高危 NSTE-ACS 建议 24h 内造影，极高危（血流动力学不: Timing of revascularization: high-risk NSTE-ACS is advised to have angiography within 24 h, while very high risk (haemodynamic instability, recurrent ischaemia) needs immediate intervention.
map.默认数据演练（NSTE-ACS GRACE 风险评估）: Default data walkthrough (NSTE-ACS GRACE risk assessment)
map.：输入：男、68 岁、心率 102、收缩压 100、肌酐 130、Killip: : Input: male, 68 years old, heart rate 102, systolic pressure 100, creatinine 130, Killip I, troponin elevated, ST depression, no arrest. Tool output: GRACE about 138 points, stratified as high risk, recommends an invasive strategy within 24 h (coronary angiography plus PCI if needed), warning to seek care immediately if ischaemia recurs. Note: the score changes with the measurements, and the bedside reading governs.

map.GRACE 与 TIMI 有何区别？: What is the difference between GRACE and TIMI?
map.GRACE 覆盖更广（含血压、肌酐、Killip 等），预测院内与远期死亡/缺血: GRACE covers more (blood pressure, creatinine, Killip class and so on) and predicts in-hospital and long-term death/ischaemia more robustly; TIMI is for NSTE-ACS ischaemic events and has fewer items. The two complement each other, and clinical practice usually follows guidelines and uses GRACE to time the invasive strategy.
map.高危就一定要造影吗？: Does high risk always mean angiography?
map.高危 NSTE-ACS 推荐早期（多 24h 内）冠脉造影，极高危（心源性休克、: High-risk NSTE-ACS is recommended for early coronary angiography (mostly within 24 h), while very high risk (cardiogenic shock, refractory ischaemia, life-threatening arrhythmia) requires immediate intervention; but whether and when to operate also depends on stability, bleeding risk and team conditions.
map.评分会随病情变吗？: Does the score change with the condition?
map.会。血压、心率、肌酐、标志物在就诊过程中动态变化，GRACE 应据最新值重评；趋: Yes. Blood pressure, heart rate, creatinine and markers change dynamically during the hospital stay, so GRACE should be reassessed with the latest values; the trend reflects deterioration or improvement better than a single reading and guides monitoring and reassessment.
